units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:13">Esth. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>שתי ספינית היו עולות בל׳ אחת מבקשת וכ׳</he> two ships attempting to enter the harbor (from different directions); one desires a northern wind &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:8:9">Y. Yoma III, 41ᵃ</cite> <he>לְמֵינָהּ של יפו</he> the harbor of Japho.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:1:10">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>למינה של קסרין</he> of Cæsarea.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>אם … שתהא עומדת בל׳</he> if a man wants to build a ship able to stand in the harbor; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 876:10">Yalk. Ps. 876</cite> <he>במים</he>).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 4:2">Erub. IV, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 41b">41ᵇ</cite>) <he>נכנסו ללמן</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לנָמֵל</he>).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 48">Ex. R. s. 48</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1">Koh. R. to VII, 1</cite> (ref. to ‘the day of death’ &c.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1">ib.</cite>) it is like two sea-faring ships <he>אחת יוצאת מן הל׳ וכ׳</he> one leaving the harbor, and one entering it; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 973">Yalk. Koh. 973</cite> <cite ref="N00881"><he>נמל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:5">Koh. R. to VI, 5</cite>; a. e.
